name: Krishna-Radha Shrine
town_description: Baijnath is a small town in Kangra district, Himachal Pradesh, in the Beas valley on the banks of the Binwa river, about 16 km from Palampur at the foothills of the Dhauladhar range. It grew around the 13th-century Vaidyanath Shiva temple and remains a major Shaivite pilgrimage stop, also serving as a gateway to paragliding at Bir-Billing and the Tibetan monasteries of the valley.
